correctness.rationale: Angular generator L=d∂θ²+ω∂θ+r(f(0)−f) has invariant moments m_k=r/(r+k²d−ikω); first-harmonic conditional relaxation at rate r+d, rotation ω yields the integrable velocity covariance e^{−(r+d)t}R(ωt)S. Symmetric Green–Kubo with 1/(2t) covariance normalization gives Z=v²(m₂−m₁²)/(r+d−iω). Independent SymPy expansion exactly reproduces the stated rational numerator, denominator and two partial derivatives −16v²/(243d²), −16iv²/(243d²) at r=d/2,ω=0. The imaginary numerator −2dω forces ω=0; the remaining d²−2dr forces r=d/2. Ambient D I is isotropic. Local O(h²+ω²) remainder uses analytic denominator. All positive r,d,v, real ω and D≥0 are covered; zero/reset-limit claims are not made.
